usage: verify_film.py [-h] [--video VIDEO] [--plan PLAN] [--proof PROOF]
                      [--output OUTPUT] [--ffmpeg FFMPEG] [--ffprobe FFPROBE]

Verify the delivered film, not just its generation plan. Requires
ffmpeg/ffprobe and Pillow (the same optional tooling as build_film.py). Exit
0: all recorded technical checks passed; 1: failed; 2: MP4 still pending. No
result from this script substitutes for viewing/listening to the actual film.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --video VIDEO
  --plan PLAN        Plan explícito; por defecto usa el plan local o la
                     evidencia de exportación incluida.
  --proof PROOF
  --output OUTPUT
  --ffmpeg FFMPEG
  --ffprobe FFPROBE

scope: Help/options inspection only in the previously created authoring venv on Windows. No regeneration, rendering, network request, Linux or macOS execution.
